description: This file implements HTTP server setup and transport installation functions for a Playwright-related SDK, including server start, address conversion, request handling, and session management with SSE and streamable transports.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Creates and starts an HTTP server with optional abort signal handling.

methods.name: httpAddressToString
methods.description: Converts various address representations to a string URL.

methods.name: installHttpTransport
methods.description: Sets up transport mechanisms on an HTTP server, including SSE and streamable sessions, with access control.
